title: FEC Campaign Finance Scraper - Candidates, Donors & Spending
description: Search US federal candidates by name/state/office/party/cycle with campaign financial totals, individual donor contributions (Schedule A), committee spending (Schedule B) or independent expenditures for/against a candidate (Schedule E), via the official FEC open.fec.gov API. No key needed.
seoTitle: FEC Scraper - Donors, Campaign Spending & Super PAC Money
seoDescription: Scrape the FEC's official API: candidates with financial totals, itemized donor contributions, committee disbursements, and independent expenditures for or against a candidate. No API key needed.

result.eventDescription: One result row: a candidate record (with financial totals if requested), a donor contribution, a committee disbursement, or an independent expenditure.
